notes.title: 🏆 Achievements Update & Future Plans
notes.notes:
Hello adventurers,

I have just rolled out a visual upgrade to all 810 achievements in the game! Each achievement now has a refreshed, higher-quality look to better reflect the game's style.

Since the game is set in Middle Eastern-style mazes, I have also introduced some Arabic letters as part of the achievement visuals — something I have not seen in other games, and I hope it adds a unique touch for collectors.

✅ Important:
If you have already unlocked achievements, your progress is safe — nothing has been reset. This update is purely visual and applies to everyone automatically.



🔮 What's Next for the Game?
I am planning to enhance the gameplay while staying true to its core:

The main story and structure remain the same: you will still be navigating complex mazes from a 2.5D top-down view, trying to save the princess.

However, I am working on making the world feel more alive and tense — with smarter enemies, more personality, and less predictability. Enemies will eventually react to your presence, not just follow fixed patrol paths.

These changes aim to deepen the experience without altering the soul of the game.



🎯 A Note for Achievement Hunters
In the past, it was possible to unlock all achievements simply by idling. That will gradually change — future updates will make achievements more closely tied to gameplay progress and exploration. I believe this will offer a more rewarding and memorable experience.

Thank you all for your continued support. I am excited for what is ahead, and I hope you will enjoy both the new look and the deeper journey coming soon.

Stay sharp,
Fürst

notes.title: Thomaz received a major update
notes.notes:
Thomaz has now received a major update that changed a lot of things about the game. 

Here are the details:
[list]
[*] The game was changed from tho_maz to Thomaz, in order to make it look better.
[*] Achievements were updated. The game now has 800+ & better looking achievements.
[*] Achievements now have letters and numbers with 3 different fonts and 6 different colors. The achievements also include special characters like [b]ä, ë, ç[/b].
[*] Game menu, UI and dialogs were also updated to look better.
[/list]

You can get the achievements either by completing the game.

notes.title: tho_maz now has 750 achievements! And trading cards are coming soon.
notes.notes:
Greetings!

According to the news from the Royal High Committee, the saviors of our unique and precious princess will now be rewarded with 750 Steam achievements after playing the game for 2 hours! 

Another member of the Royal High Committee has confirmed that Steam trading cards are also on their way to the game, soon.

[i]Best regards,[/i]
[b]Fürst.[/b]
